phases.name: Reload
phases.description: Re-introduce loading safely now that the nerve symptoms have settled. Machine and supported lifts with a neutral neck, daily neck maintenance, and tendon-loading for the elbow. Walking only — no running yet.

phases.name: Build
phases.description: Step up to free-weight compounds with progressive overload. Introduce easy, low-volume run-walk intervals as light cardio. Strength stays the priority.

phases.name: Strength
phases.description: Heavier compound lifts with a neutral neck, the cautious reintroduction of overhead pressing, and full elbow loading. Easy continuous runs build toward 15 minutes.

phases.name: Perform
phases.description: Maintain and auto-regulate your strength, keep a comfortable ~25-minute light run twice a week, and hold neck/elbow work at a maintenance dose. This is your sustainable steady state.
